summary: Independent DAY-shift discovery pass confirms two material weak-signal clusters: purpose-built AV commercialization is constrained by an active certification transition rather than simple deregulation, and grid/distribution innovation remains an active public-investment bottleneck theme. XTND remains the only canonical outside-250 challenger in the current discovery pool, with fresh SEC evidence of substantial equity-plan capacity. The full cadence-due active gating discovery-family sweep was not reproduced in this pass, so acquisition is incomplete and no canonical score/rank influence is proposed.

materialFindings.finding: NHTSA's September 4, 2026 Audit Query into Tesla Cybercab self-certification specifically tests whether a purpose-built vehicle without traditional human controls complies with applicable FMVSS. This supports certification/regulatory throughput as a real autonomy deployment constraint distinct from technical autonomy capability.

The same regulatory regime is simultaneously lowering design-rule friction: NHTSA previously announced streamlined AV exemptions and a temporary Zoox commercial-deployment exemption. The weak signal is therefore regime transition with both faster pathways and active enforcement, not one-directional deregulation.

DOE's September 10, 2026 Feeder of the Future awards explicitly target distribution feeders that can handle variable supply/demand, on-site generation and distributed devices while improving reliability. This independently reinforces distribution-grid architecture and operational tooling as an active successor bottleneck as generation capacity expands.

XTND's September 4 Form S-8 registers 9,936,483 rollover-award shares, 18,630,959 shares under the 2026 equity incentive plan, and 15,000,000 shares under the employee stock purchase plan. This does not establish actual dilution by itself, but it is a material capital-structure weak signal that must remain upstream of any admission or opportunity judgment.

contradictions.issue: AV policy cannot be characterized as simply permissive: commercial exemptions/rule modernization coexist with active self-certification enforcement.
